author: Okamura, 1897

note.en: A small creeping Caulerpa known here from herbarium specimens collected at the Piuta reef and beach near Limón.
note.es: Una Caulerpa pequeña y rastrera conocida aquí por especímenes de herbario recogidos en el arrecife y la playa de Piuta, cerca de Limón.

evidence: GBIF: 3 preserved specimens near Puerto Limón (Piuta Beach, 2019, in sand with Caulerpa prolifera, 0.5 m; Piuta Point reef)

sources.t: GBIF specimen records, Piuta, Puerto Limón (MICH herbarium)
Marine macroalgae of Costa Rica, Pacific and Caribbean, Helgoland Marine Research 2009

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: GBIF: 3 preserved specimens near Puerto Limón (Piuta Beach, 2019, in sand with Caulerpa prolifera, 0.5 m; Piuta Point reef).
